snippet.title: ArcaneBound - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Action-RPG bullet heaven

ArcaneBound is a 2D pixel-art action RPG where you fight hordes, loot cards, and build a deck to wipe out entire waves of monsters. Dying isn’t the end: time resets, but your build keeps evolving.

23 November 2026

Play the DEMO now on steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4463480/ArcaneBound/
